description: Appointment of a Committee to issue National Electricity Policy and Policy Guidelines
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-09-08 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - In terms of the provisions of the Sri Lanka Electricity Act, No.36 of 2024, as amended by the Sri Lanka Electricity (Amendment) Act, No.14 of 2025, a Committee consisting of not more than 8 persons with at least 15 years of expertise in the fields of energy policy making, renewable energy and energy transition, energy system planning, economics and finance shall be appointed by the Minister in charge of the subject with the approval of the Cabinet of Ministers to prepare the draft National Electricity Policy as part of the National Policy on Energy. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Energy to appoint the relevant Committee consisting of the following persons, was approved by the Cabinet.•    Prof. Mohan Munasinghe•    President's Counsel Milinda Gunetilleke•    Prof. Arulampalam Atputharajah•    Eng. W.J.L. Shavindranath Fernando•    Dr. H.M. Gunatilake
